leaves.doc: elkies-print: Elkies, Shimura curve computations (ANTS-III 1998) section 3 on X*(6) = X6/W, for every witness of the moduli description of X0(6,1) (R1fpPropsAb, X6Props), with no existence claim: some t : X6 -> P1 with Q(X6)^W = Q(t) (whenever X6 is integral and t regular at its generic point, both proved from the charts), t = 0, 1, infinity at the CM points of discriminant -24, -4, -3, and the charts s^2 = -t, r^2 = 3(t-1) (section, display and 0/infinity orientation UNVERIFIED). The witness comes from gonzalezRotgerX6Ab (or any X6WitnessAb source). Replaces elkiesX6StarFunctionField; equivalent to it given a witness and T5 (every_iff_functionField).
leaves.source: Elkies 1998 (ANTS-III, LNCS 1423) section 3, X*(6) = X6/W with coordinate t (function-field form Q(X6)^W = Q(t)), CM values and equations of X6 over the t-line, on every witness of the moduli description of X0(6,1), no existence claim (section, display and 0/infinity orientation UNVERIFIED)
